title: 👀 Doomsday plane (73-1676) within sight of the farm: look SSE, about 6° up, 12 mi away
body:

- **Height:** about 6,088 ft above the farm's ground, heading ENE, 270 kt
- **Callsign:** TITAN29; ICAO ADFEB3

[ADS-B Exchange](https://globe.adsbexchange.com/?icao=adfeb3) · [Farm receiver (farm network only)](http://192.168.1.190/tar1090/?icao=adfeb3) · [Live map](https://rdbfarm.github.io/iad-map/live.html)
